contextual_policy.input: current exact residual CNF and current state_cap only
per_live_variable: positive = number of current residual clauses containing +v
negative = number of current residual clauses containing -v
incident_units = sum(1+clause_width) over current residual clauses containing either sign of v
max_resolvent_width_upper = max_positive_tail + max_negative_tail when parent_pairs>0 else 0
contextual_policy.proof_carrying_reason: Every non-tautological parent pair can add at most one resolvent of width at most max_positive_tail+max_negative_tail; counting every pair, including duplicates and pairs that actually become tautologies, can only overestimate raw units. Therefore certified_raw_upper_units is an upper bound on eliminate_var_capped raw_units.

feature_work_accounting.live_variable_scores: number of live variables returned by original canonical_pivot_order

algorithm: Start with connectivity backbone i=1..8 on supports [i,i+1,i+2] with independent rng.getrandbits(1) signs.
Sample three distinct variables uniformly from 1..10 with independent signs until 42 unique canonical non-tautological width-3 clauses exist.
Canonical clause literal order is (abs(literal), literal<0); formula clause insertion order is preserved.
No SAT result, prior R1 result, Slime score or exact solver output participates in generation.

gate.R2_combined_work: R2 exact solver paid_work + contextual feature_work
gate.strict_improvement_required: R2 has more decisive results OR equal decisive results and strictly lower combined_work
